name: contact-page
title: Contact page
description: The contact page template, built only from library items: the heading and a line beside a form on the #262626 fill (name, work email, message, one White button), the header and the footer row.
use_for: A website's contact page. Edit lib/pages/contact.ts or pass `content`; the form posts to `content.form.action`, or `onSubmit` (the element's `send` event) takes the values.
never: An address, phone number or reply time you cannot keep
More fields than you need, or a second White button
New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
source: Built from the library (site header, field, input, textarea, button, footer row); the brand assets have no contact layout, so it follows the page templates and the plan card's fill
body:
`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`intro`, `form`); a key left out is not shown. `menus` passes the
header menus (the live card's `picture`, the use cases' `shots`).

props.description: The sections to show, in order; all of them in the page order by default (leave one out to omit it).
